sources.source: The Death Spiral of Open Source Projects (Mendeley Data)
sources.attribution: Kaushik, Mohit; Kaur Chahal, Kuljit (2026), Mendeley Data, V2, doi: 10.17632/xxf9nh6y9s.2
sources.notes: Dataset comprises 4M pull requests & 6.3M comments across 3,472 repositories (multi-gigabyte replication package). Requires manual download from Mendeley Data web portal due to dynamic Cloudflare protection and on-demand large archive generation.

Backend integration active with pagination, rate-limit header parsing (x-ratelimit-remaining, x-ratelimit-reset), and in-memory TTL caching. Requires GITHUB_TOKEN environment variable for higher rate limits.
